summary: All assigned Silverline review points are done and committed on int/silver. The suites smoke, bank.*, insurance.* and finance.* pass: 39 suites, 871 checks, 0 failures, 0 red errors in the log. Two caveats: a save without the mod was not loaded (the test harness cannot do that), and the 1280x720 check only covers the window size, not the other ways a window can be cut off.
done: A3: BankModule.PrepareRemoval now runs Collections.CleanUpForRemoval. It removes the agency's lords, destroys or discards its agents (map and world pawns), clears BankGameComp.collectors, sets the relation to neutral, and queues the faction for removal by vanilla's FactionManager.Remove. The agency is now created as a temporary faction, so vanilla also deletes it on its own when idle. InsuranceModule.PrepareRemoval removes our letters (ClaimLetter and any letter using an SL_ letter def) from the letter stack and the archive. Silverline defines no hediffs, and its thoughts are situational and never saved. What remains is documented in docs/removal_silverline.md. New suite bank.removal.

A9: Removed both GetFloatMenuOptions patches (insurance and finance). A single GetCommTargets patch now adds three ICommunicable entries (Silverline, ClawbackComm, and the fallback finance window), so the vanilla UseCommsConsole job sends the colonist to the console first. Tradeable.ResolveTrade no longer skips vanilla: the prefix only records state, and a postfix moves the delivered silver, from the ground or from incoming drop pods, onto the account less the deposit fee. If no delivery is found, nothing is taken. New suite bank.comms; bank.trade rewritten with a real trader pawn, a drop-pod case and a no-delivery case.

A10: Patch_PlayerWealth now has a real per-tick cache with no LINQ and no allocations after the first call. It refills when the tick, the balance or the wealth-share slider changes, and is reset on game init. BankGameComp.InTransit no longer uses LINQ.

B5.1: Insurance tier cards are now 200px tall. The benefit and mechanics text sit in fitted labels that cut at a word with '...' and show the full text as a tooltip (new BankUI.FitLabel and FitText). The 'Covers:' paragraph now grows with its text.

B5.2: The invest detail pane's chart takes whatever height is left (70 to 150px), the empty message reserve is gone, and the news strip is smaller on pages without the gambling hint. The 'You hold nothing here. Yet.' line is no longer sliced. The news line is truncated with a tooltip.

B5.3: The lobby 'Recent activity' list truncates the memo with '...' and a tooltip and keeps the amount column in place. The bank-name and slogan labels in the lobby strip are also truncated (BankUI.LabelCut). Checked every tab and sub-page at the default window size from a new explicit suite, silver.shots (screenshots). The window is a fixed 900x660, so it fits 1280x720 virtual pixels, but I did not re-shoot at 1280x720; the one emulation run used 1280x803 (a stricter 720p was not re-run). The Terms slider labels overlap slightly; left as is.
B11: bank.tradeDeposit now defaults to false. The lobby bank strip has a visible 'Auto-deposit trade silver' checkbox with a tooltip, greyed out while direct deposit is off.

B12: SL_RimHealth baseRisk is now 4.0, with a paid-days cap of 5 per colonist in any 15 days. The cap is two new settings (insurance.hospitalCapDays and insurance.hospitalCapWindow) and a saved per-contract log. The def texts are updated. New suite insurance.cap, including an in-game check that 8 consecutive sick days pay at most 50 silver on Bare Minimum.

B12 re-check: SL_GoldenYears was a silver printer. A 60-plus colonist could buy a pension and collect the lump sum or annuity almost at once for about 20 silver a quadrum. Now a colonist aged 60 or older cannot sign, and the premium is the fair value of the pension divided by the quadrums left until age 60, with no deductible and no history blend. Property policies already scale with building wealth. The ReportFine, ReportLiability and ReportClosure claims have no callers outside tests, so they are inert; I did not change them.
rejected: A3 (partial): 'Custom lord jobs and hediffs' are not Silverline's. It uses only vanilla lord job classes and defines no hediffs. The Wellness and Kitchen hediffs and the Nobles/Cinema lord jobs the reviewer lists are outside my scope. The reviewer's claim that a leftover agency 'corrupts the world load' is overstated: vanilla's FactionManager.ExposeData drops factions with a null def and logs one error.

A9 'merge the duplicate GetFloatMenuOptions patches into one': done by removing both and using the one GetCommTargets patch, not by keeping a merged float-menu patch. The vanilla menu then handles the 'can use comms now' and 'can talk' checks itself.
tests: cd <worktree> && MODDIR=$PWD tools/run_test.sh 'smoke,bank.*,insurance.*,finance.*' silver5: PASS, 39 suites, 871 checks, 0 failures, 0 errors in log
New or changed suites: bank.removal, bank.comms, bank.trade (rewritten), insurance.cap, insurance.tricks (golden-years pricing); the explicit suite silver.shots is for screenshots only
notes_for_integrator: Keyed files: HH_Bank.xml is regenerated by tools/gen_bank_keys.py, so another worktree touching it will conflict; rerun the script after merging. HH_Insurance.xml gained one key, Sign.TooOld.
New HSettings keys: insurance.hospitalCapDays (5) and insurance.hospitalCapWindow (15). The bank.tradeDeposit default is now false; saves that stored an explicit value keep it.

New public types in Silverline: ConsoleComm, SilverlineComm, ClawbackComm and SilverlineFallbackComm (BankPatches.cs). Patch_CommsConsole_Menu and Patch_CommsConsole_Silverline are gone. PolicyContract has two new saved lists (bedLogPawn, bedLogDay) that are null-safe on load.

The collection agency faction is now temporary, so vanilla removes it when none of its people are on a map. Collections.Housekeeping also queues removal of an idle agency, which includes factions from older saves.
Hearth items from the same review (Patch_PitDamageGuard, WellFed, the kitchen recipe cleanup, the guest tabs) were not touched; they are outside this scope.

bank.shots, an existing suite that runs under bank.*, advances about 2.7 million ticks. It is shared by every worktree through /private/tmp/claude-501/hh_tests/bank_shots. My screenshots went to /private/tmp/claude-501/hh_tests/silver_shots_i.
